text: 从国家发展改革委今天举行的“奋进‘十五五’”系列新闻发布会上了解到，目前我国油气消费约占终端能源消费的三分之一，主要集中在交通、工业等领域，仍然有较大替代空间。“十五五”期间，将多措并举推进油气消费电能替代。
text_en: It was learned from the National Development and Reform Commission's "Forging Ahead on the 15th Five-Year Plan" series press conference held today that China's oil and gas consumption currently accounts for about one-third of final energy consumption, mainly concentrated in transportation, industry and other sectors, and there is still significant room for substitution. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, multiple measures will be taken to advance the substitution of oil and gas consumption with electricity.
